concept.cypher: MATCH (c:Class) WITH c, CASE WHEN c.fqn STARTS WITH "mjvm.cli" THEN "cli" WHEN c.fqn STARTS WITH "mjvm.compiler" THEN "compiler" WHEN c.fqn STARTS WITH "mjvm.runtime" THEN "runtime" WHEN c.fqn STARTS WITH "mjvm.ir" THEN "ir" WHEN c.fqn STARTS WITH "jvmumps.store" THEN "store" WHEN c.fqn STARTS WITH "jvmumps" THEN "jvmumps" ELSE "other" END AS layer MERGE (l:Layer {name: layer}) MERGE (c)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(l) RETURN count(*) AS assigned

constraint.description: mjvm.compiler must not depend on mjvm.runtime (except emitters)
constraint.cypher: MATCH (a:Class)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(b:Class) WHERE a.fqn STARTS WITH "mjvm.compiler" AND b.fqn STARTS WITH "mjvm.runtime" AND NOT a.name ENDS WITH "Emitter" RETURN a.fqn AS Compiler, b.fqn AS RuntimeDependency

constraint.description: mjvm.ir must not depend on mjvm.runtime or mjvm.compiler
constraint.cypher: MATCH (a:Class)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(b:Class) WHERE a.fqn STARTS WITH "mjvm.ir" AND (b.fqn STARTS WITH "mjvm.runtime" OR b.fqn STARTS WITH "mjvm.compiler") RETURN a.fqn AS IrClass, b.fqn AS ForbiddenDependency

constraint.description: jvmumps.store must not depend on mjvm.compiler or mjvm.runtime
constraint.cypher: MATCH (a:Class)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(b:Class) WHERE a.fqn STARTS WITH "jvmumps.store" AND (b.fqn STARTS WITH "mjvm.compiler" OR b.fqn STARTS WITH "mjvm.runtime") RETURN a.fqn AS StoreClass, b.fqn AS ForbiddenDependency

constraint.description: No classes outside jvmumps may depend on Cdb2Store
constraint.cypher: MATCH (a:Class)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(b:Class) WHERE b.fqn ENDS WITH "Cdb2Store" AND NOT a.fqn STARTS WITH "jvmumps" RETURN a.fqn AS Consumer, b.fqn AS Cdb2Store
